en: A sepia-toned postcard depicting a Renaissance-style building with elaborate stonework and numerous windows. There is a statue in the foreground, surrounded by a fence, and a lamp post nearby. The scene seems quiet and historic. The text at the bottom identifies the building as the Palais de Justice in Grenoble, also noting its historical function as the former palace of the Cour des Comptes of the Parlement de Dauphiné.
